proposition: His father Afżal al-Dīn seems to have been in contact with Fażl Allāh Astarābādī, and Hurufi sources have the father and Ibn Turka's elder brother Ṣadr al-Dīn consult Fażl Allāh in Isfahan to have their dreams interpreted; Melvin-Koushki says the contact implies no Hurufi inclination on their part.

mediation.who: Hurufi hagiographical sources (Nāfajī's Khwābnāma and others)
mediation.note: MK: the point of the story is Fażl Allāh's fame, not the Turkas' loyalty
